bag.note: Tile bag: 100 tiles (20 each of 5 colors). Server shuffles and draws to fill factories.

box_lid.note: Discarded tiles accumulate here; refill bag when bag is empty.

factory_1.note: Factory display 1: holds 4 tiles drawn from bag.

factory_2.note: Factory display 2: holds 4 tiles drawn from bag.

factory_3.note: Factory display 3: holds 4 tiles drawn from bag.

factory_4.note: Factory display 4: holds 4 tiles drawn from bag.

factory_5.note: Factory display 5: holds 4 tiles drawn from bag.

center.note: Center of table: receives remainder tiles from factory picks. First player to take from center gets the first-player marker and a -1 penalty.

pattern_row_2.note: Pattern line row 2: holds up to 2 tiles of same color.

pattern_row_3.note: Pattern line row 3: holds up to 3 tiles of same color.

pattern_row_4.note: Pattern line row 4: holds up to 4 tiles of same color.

pattern_row_5.note: Pattern line row 5: holds up to 5 tiles of same color.

wall.note: 5x5 wall grid. Each row has a fixed color pattern determining which column a color goes into. Tiles placed here score by adjacency.

floor_line.note: Overflow tiles and first-player penalty. Slots penalize: -1, -1, -2, -2, -2, -3, -3.

score.note: Running score for each player. Cannot go below 0.

tile.note: 20 tiles of each of 5 colors. Drawn from bag to factories, drafted by players, placed on pattern lines, then moved to wall.

first_player_marker.note: Placed in center at start of round. First player to take from center takes this marker (and a -1 floor penalty) and goes first next round.

phases.name: factory_offer
phases.ends_when: all factories and center are empty
phases.note: Players alternate taking all tiles of one color from a factory (remainder to center) or from center. Tiles go to a pattern row; overflow to floor line.

phases.name: wall_tiling
phases.resolve: for each player, for each completed pattern row: move one tile to wall, score adjacency, discard remaining tiles to box_lid
phases.note: Completed pattern rows (row N has N tiles) move one tile to the wall at the designated column. Score 1 point per tile plus contiguous horizontal and vertical neighbors. Floor line penalties applied. Remaining tiles from pattern rows go to box_lid.

phases.name: prepare_next_round
phases.server_action: if bag empty, refill from box_lid and shuffle
phases.resolve: reset floor lines, check end condition
phases.note: If any player completed a horizontal wall row, game ends after final scoring. Otherwise start new round.

library.wall_color_pattern: row_colors[row] shifted right by row index: [[blue,yellow,red,black,white],[white,blue,yellow,red,black],[black,white,blue,yellow,red],[red,black,white,blue,yellow],[yellow,red,black,white,blue]]
library.bonus_complete_row: 2 points for each completed horizontal row on wall
library.bonus_complete_column: 7 points for each completed vertical column on wall
library.bonus_complete_color: 10 points for all 5 tiles of one color on wall

constraints: chosen color exists on the factory
take ALL tiles of chosen color from factory
remaining tiles on that factory move to center
draft_from_factory.definition: Pick all tiles of one color from a factory display. Non-chosen tiles go to center.

constraints: take ALL tiles of chosen color from center
if first_player_marker is in center, take it and add it to floor line
draft_from_center.definition: Pick all tiles of one color from the center pool. First player to do so takes the first-player marker.

constraints: pattern row must be empty or already contain tiles of the same color
the corresponding wall row must not already have a tile of this color
tiles that do not fit in the pattern row overflow to the floor line
pattern_row_placement.definition: Place drafted tiles onto a pattern row (1-5 slots). Excess goes to floor.

wall_tiling.effect: for each completed pattern row (row N has N tiles): place 1 tile on wall at fixed column for that color, score by adjacency, discard N-1 tiles to box_lid
wall_tiling.definition: Move tiles from full pattern rows to the wall and score.

adjacency_scoring.definition: When placing a tile on the wall: if no adjacent tiles, score 1. Otherwise score 1 for the tile plus 1 for each contiguously connected tile horizontally, plus 1 for each contiguously connected tile vertically. If tile has both horizontal and vertical neighbors, it counts once in each direction.
adjacency_scoring.note: A tile placed with 2 horizontal neighbors and 1 vertical neighbor scores (1+2) + (1+1) = 5.

floor_penalty.effect: subtract floor_penalties[i] for each tile i in floor_line, minimum score 0
floor_penalty.definition: Floor penalties: slots 1-2 = -1 each, slots 3-5 = -2 each, slots 6-7 = -3 each.

end_of_round.effect: discard floor tiles to box_lid, if bag empty refill from box_lid and shuffle, refill factories
end_of_round.definition: Clean up and prepare next round.

final_scoring.effect: bonus: +2 per complete horizontal row, +7 per complete vertical column, +10 per complete color (all 5 on wall)

end_conditions.condition: any player has a completed horizontal wall row AND this player has highest score after final scoring
end_conditions.name: highest_score_wins

end_conditions.condition: any player has a completed horizontal wall row AND scores are tied after final scoring
end_conditions.name: tied_scores
